digest.component_or_area: generic property test for reads under contention (store interface)
propositions: The generic property _assert_complete_or_loud checks shape validity but does not validate content completeness, allowing truncated payloads (empty objects or records missing ticket_id) to pass on all four surfaces (show/list/search/ready).

Seeded faults F3 (show emits {} with exit 0) and F6 (show emits record without ticket_id, exit 0) pass the existing generic property tests while failing the regression test test_show_no_stall.py::test_cli_show_complete_or_erroring_under_write_burst.

The fix extends SURFACES with per-surface content-completeness predicates: show requires truthy ticket_id on the returned object; list/search/ready require every element to carry truthy ticket_id, with empty arrays remaining valid.
The change is assertion-only with no new subprocess invocations, rounds, or fixtures, so wall-clock runtime is unchanged.
After the fix, both seeded faults F3 and F6 cause the generic property tests to fail, while the unseeded tree and valid-empty arrays continue to pass.
